chunks: Maqam Ibrahim, peace be upon him.

Then go to Maqam Ibrahim, peace be upon him, and perform two rak'ahs there, placing it before you. Recite in the first of them al-Hamd and Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad, and in the second al-Hamd and Qul Ya Ayyuha al-Kafirun. Then recite the tashahhud and taslim, praise Allah, extol Him, and send blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله. Ask Allah, Exalted is He, to accept it from you and not make it your last عهد. These two rak'ahs are the obligation, and it is not disliked for you to perform them at whatever hours you wish, at sunrise and at sunset. Their time is only when you have finished the tawaf, so long as it is not the time of an obligatory salat. If it is the time of an obligatory salat, then begin with it and then perform the two rak'ahs of tawaf. When you finish the two rak'ahs, then say:

All praise belongs to Allah with all His praises for all His blessings, until praise reaches what my Lord loves and is pleased with. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, accept from me, purify my heart, and purify my deed.

Strive in supplication and ask Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to accept from you. Then go to the Black Stone and touch it, and kiss it, or wipe it with your hand, or gesture toward it, and say what you said, or not, for that is unavoidable.

key_terms.الدُّعَاءِ: Supplication made after the prayer, asking Allah for acceptance.
key_terms.الطَّوَافِ: The circumambulation of the Ka'bah, after which this prayer is performed.
key_terms.الْحَجَرَ الْأَسْوَدَ: The Black Stone, which one then approaches, touches, kisses, or indicates toward.
key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةُ: The obligatory duty; here, the two rak'ahs of tawaf are described as obligatory.
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: The two units of prayer required after completing tawaf.
key_terms.صَلَاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ: An obligatory prescribed salat whose time may take precedence.
key_terms.مَقامَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: The Station of Ibrahim عليه السلام, where the two rak'ahs after tawaf are performed.

ai.seo_question: How should the two rak'ahs of tawaf at Maqam Ibrahim be performed in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This passage gives the rulings and supplications for the two obligatory rak'ahs after tawaf at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام. It explains what to recite, when the prayer is to be performed, the exception when an obligatory salat time has entered, and the recommended du'a and return to the Black Stone.
